# Savewave

## Overview

Savewave is a free, privacy-focused media resolver and downloader created by Kuber Bassi. Its user flow is Paste -> Resolve -> Preview -> Save.

## Supported public sources

- YouTube: videos, Shorts, and audio where the source can be resolved.
- Instagram: public posts, Reels, photos, videos, and carousels.
- Facebook: public videos, Reels, and post media.
- Threads: public post images and videos.
- X / Twitter: public images and videos.
- SoundCloud: publicly resolvable audio.
- Spotify: public track metadata plus strict, high-confidence matching to a downloadable audio source. Audio is not downloaded from Spotify.
- Direct URLs: common video, audio, and image formats.

Private, login-gated, Story, cookie-only, and browser-session-only media is intentionally rejected. Support depends on what each public source exposes and may change when a source changes its delivery system.

## Download behavior

Savewave automatically detects the source and selects a compatible result. A resolved item is shown as a preview before the Save action. The final target is validated again before the browser download begins. Spotify matches must pass title, artist, version, channel, and duration confidence checks.

## Privacy and storage

- No user accounts.
- No application database.
- No permanent server-side media storage.
- Download history stays in the browser and has a fixed display limit with an explicit Load more action.
- Savewave does not accept account cookies or browser sessions.

## Canonical links

- Website: https://savewave.kuberbassi.com/
- Source and documentation: https://github.com/kuberbassi/savewave
- Creator: https://kuberbassi.com/

## Responsible use

Users are responsible for downloading only media they are authorized to save and for following source terms and applicable law.
